scope: Independent design review of the Debug/Metro package-level Q13 method; no tool implementation, runtime, private checkout, or device acceptance.

findings.runtimeConstraint: Release has __DEV__ false, so the existing smoke Auth Emulator configuration is intentionally unavailable. Debug/Metro smoke mode uses the existing supported local Auth Emulator and API readiness checks without relaxing product guards.
findings.q13Equivalence: Exact OOD23 source creates and cold-resumes a persisted unanswered session; exact OOD24 Metro source then invokes the existing exact resolver and must fail closed while preserving session order and zero-answer facts. A fresh nonce receipt proves the selected instrumented JavaScript executed. This verifies content-package mismatch/resume, not an OS-binary update.
findings.sidecarContract: The Metro-only sidecar must bind unchanged source-binding hash/nonce, content identity, actual Metro PID/CWD/port, existing Debug app identity, and the matching runtime receipt. It must be explicitly Metro mode and must not create build hashes or call the packaged comparator.
findings.preservationCondition: If ordinary SDK auth changes active profile from Guest to the existing account, compare the account's own 18-record/21-key baseline after selection and before Q13 UI. Guest's 81-record/84-key baseline alone does not cover account data.
findings.processOwnership: For restoring current Debug and baseline cleanup, verify and reuse the reported healthy current Metro listener when its PID/CWD matches the expected source. Sidecar acceptance gates OOD23/OOD24-dependent UI, not independent restoration/cleanup.
findings.failureBoundary: The previous Release entry receipt does not diagnose SecureStore/Keychain. A repeated profile gate failure stops without retry, repair, bypass, or bootstrap; successful startup does not prove the prior cause.
findings.stateSafety: One existing iPhone 17, sequential source-bound Metro processes, no app-data clear/uninstall, no new account, no Guest transfer/discard, no RevenueCat, and no Firestore/API writes are appropriate constraints.

notClaimed: iOS binary update or unmodified Release execution
